summary: An item menu with Rename, a Color submenu, a Move to submenu and a destructive Delete, reporting the last action.
use: Menus where a secondary list (colors, destination groups) would make the main menu long: the list opens beside the item.
spec: Each sub has `{#snippet trigger()}<DropdownMenuSubTrigger>Color</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>{/snippet}` (Color, Move to) and its options as `DropdownMenuItem` children from `{#each colors as color}` and `{#each groups as group}`
Colors are Red, Green, Blue; groups are Inbox, Archive, Projects
`let last = $state('')` is set per item and shown as `Last action: {last}` with `aria-live="polite"`
